verdict.rationale: Kong can be self-hosted, which lets users control where data is processed and stored: DB-less mode, Kubernetes, local Docker data planes, and hybrid control-plane/data-plane separation without vendor lock-in. AI Gateway logs stay on the local data plane by default. However, nothing in the evidence documents choosing a region or residency for the Konnect SaaS control plane, so this support is inferred from deployment flexibility rather than an explicit residency feature. Missing for 10: explicit Konnect region/geo selection, data-residency documentation or guarantees, independent corroboration.
